paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма представя сравнение на изчислителните разходи и ефективността на различни техники за фино настройване на езикови модели, използвайки Llama-3-8B, за десет задачи за обработка на естествен език. Хоризонталната ос съдържа категории на техники за фино настройване, включително Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, MTLoRA, QLoRA и Ours. Осовата скала е логаритмична, за да се покаже диапазона от FLOPs (операции с плаваща запетая на секунда), като началната стойност е 1e18 и надписва стойностите от 1e18 до 1e20. Основните стълбове представляват разходите за FLOPs за всяка техника, като височината на стълбовете е пряко пропорционална на броя на FLOPs. Освен това в долната част на диаграмата е включен стълб, оцветен в зелено, който представлява подхода Ours.  Най-високата стълба за Full FT е около 1e20 FLOPs, като стълбовете на QLoRA и Ours са около 1e19 FLOPs, а стълбовете на LoRA, MTLoRA и TAG са приблизително 1e18 FLOPs.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of the number of floating-point operations per second (FLOPs) achieved by different model training methods. The horizontal axis represents model names, displaying the labels “Full FT,” “TAG,” “LoRA,” “MTL-FT,” “QLoRA,” “LoRA-FT,” and “Ours” in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents FLOPs, ranging from approximately 10<sup>18</sup> to 10<sup>20</sup>, with a logarithmic scale. The value axis is labeled “# FLOPs,” and the scale is logarithmic, with tick labels spaced by a factor of 10. The bar corresponding to “Full FT” has a height of approximately 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs, while the bar for “Ours” has a height of approximately 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs. The bar for “QLoRA” reaches approximately 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs, while the bar for “LoRA-FT” reaches approximately 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs, and the bar for “LoRA” reaches approximately 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs. The bar for “MTL-FT” is approximately 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs, and the bar for “TAG” is approximately 10<sup>18</sup> FLOPs.  The bar representing “Ours” is visually emphasized with a dark green color.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die FLOPs (Floating Point Operations per Second) für verschiedene Modelle, einschließlich QLoRA, LoRA, TAG, MTL-FT, Ours und Full FT. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Modellnamen, und die vertikale Achse stellt die FLOPs in einer logarithmischen Skala von 10^18 bis 10^20 dar. Die Werteachse ist als logarithmische Skala beschriftet und beginnt bei 10^18 und weist in regelmäßigen Intervallen Werte im Bereich von 10^18 bis 10^20 auf. Der Balken für QLoRA erstreckt sich über etwa 10^19 FLOPs. Der Balken für LoRA erreicht etwa 10^19 FLOPs. Der Balken für TAG erreicht etwa 10^18 FLOPs. Der Balken für MTL-FT erreicht etwa 10^18 FLOPs. Der Balken für QLoRA erreicht etwa 10^18 FLOPs. Der Balken für Ours erreicht etwa 10^17 FLOPs. Der Balken für Full FT erstreckt sich über etwa 10^17 FLOPs. Alle Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge sortiert, wobei der höchste Balken rechts steht.
